title: Lucky Baby Smart System 4 In 1 Ride On Push & Pull Cart
detail_text: It can be used as a walker with a parent push handle, a learn to walk cart for independent walking, a pull along toy cart and toy storage for your little one's enjoyment. Designed in an adorable shape with cute patterns, this environmental material shopping cart will attract kids’ attention. Toddlers can push this lightweight trolley around the room to pretend parents shopping, while at the same time develop their imagination, improve balance ability and exercise leg and arm muscles. Thanks to the simple structure and easy-to-understand instruction, you can assemble the mini grocery cart in a very short time. This cart features door opening for child to go in & out. A deep storage chest, offering large storage capacity for kid’s toys, dolls, fairy tales, clothes, snacks, etc. The 4-wheel construction provides great stability. The wheels are low noise, uniform speed and smooth movement. All of these features allow kids to push the cart smoothly and safely on various grounds. It is made of high-quality environmental material, which are durable and odorless. The round corners and smooth edges minimize the risk of bumps and scratches. Besides, the smooth handle is easy to grip. Open: 46.4 x 53 x 53.5cm (Height of the parent handle 79.4cm) This versatile 4-in-1 children's push and pull cart adapts to your child's growth. In walker mode, parent could push them to the park or anywhere. In pushcart mode, toddlers can practice walking while holding onto the sturdy handle. As they gain confidence on their feet, it effortlessly transforms into a pull along toy car. In storage mode, toys, snacks, and other essentials can be conveniently stored in the spacious basket. With its robust construction and non-slip wheels, children can safely explore their surroundings independently or with parental guidance. Assembly is simple, ensuring your little one's enjoyment without delay.
detail_html:
• It can be used as a walker with a parent push handle, a learn to walk cart for independent walking, a pull along toy cart and toy storage for your little one's enjoyment.
  • Designed in an adorable shape with cute patterns, this environmental material shopping cart will attract kids’ attention.
  • Toddlers can push this lightweight trolley around the room to pretend parents shopping, while at the same time develop their imagination, improve balance ability and exercise leg and arm muscles.

This wagon is portable and can be stored or taken anywhere! SAFE FOR KIDS: Radio Flyer wagons pass the ASTM-f963-13 toy safety standard and the stroller standard. This wagon includes a rear foot brake, 5-point safety harnesses and a UV protection canopy to protect your little ones from the sun. QUALITY WHEELS: This wagon features front caster wheels for nimble steering and large, 12" easy-push rear wheels. Made of high density foam, these wheels will provide a smooth, quiet ride. STORAGE CAPACITY: The Convertible Stroller Wagon can haul up to 120 lbs. of kids or cargo! It also includes a rear storage pouch to store the canopy in when not in use and two front cup holders..SPECIFICATIONS: Assembled product dimensions: 47.2" L x 41.3" W x 24.42" H. Recommended for kids 1+ years. Maximum weight capacity 150 lbs.
